verdicts.reason: A keeps the original top-to-bottom order (can, headline, body, CTA), but the SOLSTICE logo has shrunk to an illegible speck pushed off-axis into the top-right corner. The body copy also runs almost edge to edge, and the CTA is jammed against the bottom edge. B's headline is bold and dominant, but the can is cut off at the bottom canvas edge and pushed into the bottom-left corner. Its body text nearly touches the side margins, and its logo is also microscopic, so the product reads as an afterthought rather than the hero.
